source_instruction: i would like a pink hair cutting kit that is easy to use
query: Ugh, my neighbor’s tabby cat keeps sneaking onto my balcony to knock over my potted succulents, I’ve tried leaving out citrus peels and even a little motion-activated air spritzer but nothing seems to deter it for more than a day, and now the poor echeveria I’ve had for two years is missing half its leaves. Oh, and I burned my tongue really bad on that too-hot matcha latte I grabbed on the way home this afternoon, it’s still tingly even after I sipped a whole glass of cold milk. I was also thinking I should rewatch that old 90s cartoon about the lab rats this weekend since I saw a clip of it on my feed earlier, it was such a weirdly funny show. Anyway, I’m looking at hair cutting tools right now, I need one that’s fully voice-activated to operate, I want it in pink, and my budget is $20 max.
